title: GPT-4
summary: We’ve created GPT-4, the latest milestone in OpenAI’s effort in scaling up deep learning. GPT-4 is a large multimodal model (accepting image and text inputs, emitting text outputs) that, while less capable than humans in many real-world scenarios, exhibits human-level performance on various professional and academic benchmarks.
body: We’ve created GPT-4, the latest milestone in OpenAI’s effort in scaling up deep learning. GPT-4 is a large multimodal model (accepting image and text inputs, emitting text outputs) that, while less capable than humans in many real-world scenarios, exhibits human-level performance on various professional and academic benchmarks.
summaryZh: 我们创建了 GPT-4，这是 OpenAI 扩大深度学习努力的最新里程碑。 GPT-4 是一个大型多模态模型（接受图像和文本输入，发出文本输出），虽然在许多现实场景中能力不如人类，但在各种专业和学术基准上表现出人类水平的表现。
